meta_title: Product Photography Prompts for GPT Image 2 — Studio & Lifestyle
meta_description: Copy-paste product photography prompts for GPT Image 2. White studio, gradient, lifestyle, hands-only, model try-on. Upload product, generate catalog-ready shots.
intro_long: 14 tested GPT Image 2 prompts that generate catalog-ready product shots — white studio packshots, gradient hero frames, and lifestyle scenes with hands-only usage.

tips.q: How do you write a product photography prompt for GPT Image 2?
tips.a: Use the JSON template on this page: specify type, subject, scene (background/surface/props), lighting (key/fill/shadow), camera (angle/lens/framing), and output. Add `preserve product details, branding, proportions exactly` to lock the SKU. Avoid vague words like 'beautiful' — use specific lighting keywords.

tips.q: How do I create white background product photos with AI?
tips.a: Set background to `pure white seamless`, lighting to `soft diffused studio light from upper left` with `subtle bounce fill from right`, shadow to `natural soft shadow directly under product`. Output at 2K square. This matches Amazon listing guidelines and works for 90% of e-commerce SKUs.

tips.q: Can GPT Image 2 create ecommerce product images?
tips.a: Yes — image-to-image mode preserves shape, color, branding, and label text from your reference. Use the `studio-product-photography` JSON pattern for packshots, or switch to `lifestyle-scene` and `on-model` patterns for context shots. All output is catalog-ready at 2K.

tips.q: How do I keep product labels readable in AI product photos?
tips.a: Quote exact label strings in the prompt (`label_text: "VITAMIN C SERUM 30ML"`), generate at 2K resolution (10 credits) not 1K, keep the product centered with the label facing camera, and add `pixel-sharp label text, all printed copy legible` to the style field.

faq.q: How do I make professional product photos with AI?
faq.a: Upload a clean front-shot of your product, paste a prompt specifying (1) background style, (2) lighting type, (3) shadow/reflection rules, (4) composition. GPT Image 2 keeps the product SKU accurate while regenerating the entire scene. Output is catalog-ready in 30 seconds.

faq.q: What's the best AI prompt for e-commerce product photos?
faq.a: Reliable template: 'Place the [product] in [setting] with [lighting], soft natural shadow, [angle], realistic [material] texture, e-commerce ready, no extra props.' Specify your platform (Amazon / Shopify) for resolution and aspect ratio (1:1 square is standard).

faq.q: Can GPT Image 2 keep my product SKU exactly the same?
faq.a: Yes — image-to-image mode preserves shape, color, and branding of the uploaded product. To lock in details, add 'preserve product details, branding, and proportions exactly' to your prompt. Avoid words like 'redesign' or 'modify' which override the reference.

faq.q: What size for AI-generated product photos?
faq.a: Amazon listing: 2000×2000 (square, white BG). Shopify: 2048×2048 (square or 4:5). Instagram ad: 1080×1080. Use 2K resolution mode (10 credits) for any printed catalog or website hero. 1K (6 credits) is fine for social previews.

faq.q: Difference between 'product photography' and 'e-commerce product photo' prompts?
faq.a: Product photography (this page) = creative / studio / hero shots / brand storytelling. E-commerce product photo = listing-ready / on-model / SKU consistency / Amazon-Shopify compliant. Both share core templates — start here for general use, switch to ecommerce cluster for marketplace-specific compliance.

json_template._note: Product photography 推荐 JSON 结构化 prompt 锁定 SKU 一致性。{argument} 工作台解析为表单。Image-to-image 模式必填 reference 字段。

template.subject: {argument name="product_name" default="reference image attached"}
template.preserve: product details, branding, proportions, color, material exactly

lighting.key: {argument name="key_light" default="soft diffused studio light from upper left"}
lighting.shadow: {argument name="shadow" default="natural soft shadow under product"}

camera.lens: {argument name="lens" default="85mm equivalent, f/8 sharp throughout"}

post_processing.color_grade: true to product color, no over-saturation

template.output: {argument name="aspect" default="1:1 square"} 2K resolution, color accurate
